column2: PlutarchPages works offline. No telemetry, no account, and no cloud processing unless you add a provider.
column3: PlutarchPages deluje brez povezave. Brez telemetrije, brez računa in brez obdelave v oblaku, razen če dodate ponudnika.

column3: Ključ je v shrambi potrdil Windows, ki lahko zahteva dovoljenje, da ga PlutarchPages uporabi.

column2: The key is in the macOS Keychain, which may ask to allow PlutarchPages to use it.
column3: Ključ je v macOS Keychain, ki lahko zahteva dovoljenje, da ga PlutarchPages uporabi.

column2: This is a dynamic XFA form, which PlutarchPages can't display yet. What you see is the file's placeholder page.
column3: To je dinamični obrazec XFA, ki ga PlutarchPages še ne more prikazati. Tisto, kar vidite, je nadomestna stran datoteke.

column3: Dobrodošli v PlutarchPagesu

column3: {name} odda obrazec na {url}; PlutarchPages ne pošilja podatkov obrazcev. Shranite dokument, da obdržite svoje vnose.

column2: {who} in this document tried to open an address PlutarchPages won't open: {e}.
column3: {who} v tem dokumentu je poskusil odpreti naslov, ki ga PlutarchPages ne odpre: {e}.

column2: {who} in this document tried to open an address PlutarchPages won't open: {e}. Only web (http, https) and email (mailto) links open from documents.
column3: {who} v tem dokumentu je poskusil odpreti naslov, ki ga PlutarchPages ne odpre: {e}. Iz dokumentov se odpirajo samo spletne (http, https) in e-poštne (mailto) povezave.

column2: PlutarchPages is drawing without a graphics processor, so it may be slow. Updating the graphics driver may help.
column3: PlutarchPages riše brez grafičnega procesorja, zato je lahko počasen. Pomaga lahko posodobitev grafičnega gonilnika.

column2: Text recognition isn't installed: its model files are missing. Reinstall PlutarchPages, or set PDFCRAFT_MODELS to the folder that holds them.
column3: Prepoznavanje besedila ni nameščeno: manjkajo datoteke njegovih modelov. Ponovno namestite PlutarchPages ali nastavite PDFCRAFT_MODELS na mapo, v kateri so.

column2: the text recognition models are not installed (reinstall PlutarchPages, or set PDFCRAFT_MODELS to the folder that holds them)
column3: modeli za prepoznavanje besedila niso nameščeni (ponovno namestite PlutarchPages ali nastavite PDFCRAFT_MODELS na mapo, v kateri so)

column2: This field's font can't draw “{c}” ({code}), so PlutarchPages shows ? in its place. The value is saved, and other PDF viewers redraw the field from it.
column3: Pisava tega polja ne more prikazati »{c}« ({code}), zato PlutarchPages namesto njega prikaže ?. Vrednost se shrani, drugi pregledovalniki PDF pa polje znova narišejo iz nje.

column2: The fonts PlutarchPages writes with can't draw “{c}” ({code}), so it shows as ? in every PDF viewer. The text is saved.
column3: Pisave, s katerimi piše PlutarchPages, ne morejo prikazati »{c}« ({code}), zato se v vseh pregledovalnikih PDF prikaže kot ?. Besedilo se shrani.

column2: Sign a sheet of white paper and take a photo of it in bright, even light (use the flash). Choose the photo or drop it here: PlutarchPages finds the signature and removes the paper.
column3: Podpišite se na list belega papirja in ga fotografirajte v močni, enakomerni svetlobi (uporabite bliskavico). Izberite fotografijo ali jo spustite sem: PlutarchPages poišče podpis in odstrani papir.

column2: Remove this leaf tag from reading order and mark its direct content as an artifact
column3: Odstranite to listno oznako iz vrstnega reda branja in označite njeno neposredno vsebino kot artefakt

column2: Pages that use Type 3 fonts print as images, because Windows can close PlutarchPages while printing them. The other pages print as usual.
column3: Strani, ki uporabljajo pisave Type 3, se natisnejo kot slike, ker lahko Windows med njihovim tiskanjem zapre PlutarchPages. Druge strani se natisnejo kot običajno.
